mapper.insert: INSERT INTO youtube_channels ( url, channel_id, channel_name, uploads_playlist, subscriber_count, last_checked_at ) VALUES ( #{channelUrl}, #{channelId}, #{channelName}, #{uploadsPlaylist}, #{subscriberCount}, #{lastCheckedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE url = VALUES(url), channel_name = VALUES(channel_name), uploads_playlist = VALUES(uploads_playlist), subscriber_count = VALUES(subscriber_count), last_checked_at = VALUES(last_checked_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id, url, channel_id, channel_name, uploads_playlist, subscriber_count, last_checked_at, created_at, updated_at FROM youtube_channels WHERE channel_id = #{channelId}
SELECT id, url, channel_id, channel_name, uploads_playlist, subscriber_count, last_checked_at, created_at, updated_at FROM youtube_channels ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE youtube_channels SET url = #{channelUrl}, channel_name = #{channelName}, uploads_playlist = #{uploadsPlaylist}, subscriber_count = #{subscriberCount}, last_checked_at = #{lastCheckedAt} WHERE channel_id = #{channelId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO youtube_videos_raw ( channel_id, video_id, video_url, title, duration_seconds, published_at, is_imported, is_analyzed, collect_status ) VALUES ( #{channelId}, #{videoId}, #{videoUrl}, #{title}, #{durationSeconds}, #{publishedAt}, COALESCE(#{isImported}, 0), COALESCE(#{isAnalyzed}, 0), COALESCE(#{collectStatus}, 'PENDING') ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE video_url = VALUES(video_url), title = VALUES(title), duration_seconds = VALUES(duration_seconds), published_at = VALUES(published_at), collect_status = VALUES(collect_status)
mapper.select: SELECT id, channel_id, video_id, video_url, title, duration_seconds, published_at, is_imported, is_analyzed, collect_status, fetched_at, updated_at FROM youtube_videos_raw WHERE video_id = #{videoId}

SELECT id, channel_id, video_id, video_url, title, duration_seconds, published_at, is_imported, is_analyzed, collect_status, fetched_at, updated_at FROM youtube_videos_raw WHERE channel_id = #{channelId} ORDER BY published_at DESC

SELECT id, channel_id, video_id, video_url, title, duration_seconds, published_at, is_imported, is_analyzed, collect_status, fetched_at, updated_at FROM youtube_videos_raw WHERE is_analyzed = 0 ORDER BY fetched_at ASC
